title: DASH Protocol for RNA Library Preparation
author: Amy Lyden
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6rjhd4n
materials: NEB Ultra II RNA library preparation kit

Follow all steps using NEB Ultra II RNA library preparation kit. Use an input RNA volume of 25ng if available, or less if not available. Perform 12-18 cycles of indexing PCR. NEBNext Ultra II RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina - 96 rxns New England Biolabs Catalog #E7770L
Quantify by HS DNA Qubit. Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32851

Thaw necessary reagents and let come to room temperature before use. If you will not be using for more than 10 minutes, put on ice and take off 5 minutes prior to mixing. Cas9 40µM Contributed by users 10X Cas9 Activity Buffer (500mM Tris pH 8.0 - 1M NaCl - 100mM MgCL2 - 10mM TCEP) Contributed by users Dual guide RNAs (40µM - targeted to genes or regions to be depleted - crisprRNA and tracr RNA - quantified by RNA Qubit) Contributed by users
Allow the beads to separate on magnet.

Quantify and analyze your library by HS DNA Qubit and HS dsDNA Bioanalyzer. Qubit dsDNA HS Assay kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32854 Bioanalyzer chips and reagents (DNA High Sensitivity kit) Agilent Technologies This trace should resemble a regular library with a majority of the library sized between 200 – 1000bp: Same DASHed sample from above.SPRI cleaned at sample:bead ratio 1:0.7, 2 amplification cycles. steps.title: Choose DASH pooling strategy
steps.instruction: Decide between (a) pooled DASH – pool multiple samples at normalized concentrations (200–1000 bp) measured by Qubit, BioAnalyzer/TapeStation/Fragment Analyzer or by a low‑depth iSeq/MiSeq run, or pool equivolumes, DASH, resequence and re‑pool based on results – or (b) single‑sample DASH – perform an individual DASH reaction for each library and pool afterwards.

steps.title: Validate libraries on Bioanalyzer
steps.instruction: Run a High‑Sensitivity DNA Bioanalyzer (or equivalent fragment analysis) and confirm: (1) adapter dimers are absent (perform 1:1 sample:SPRI bead clean‑ups if needed), (2) sufficient DNA in the 200–1000 bp range, (3) no “PCR bubble” (secondary high‑bp bump). If a bubble is present, add 1–2 extra PCR cycles using 100 ng DNA in 23 µL H₂O, 25 µL Kapa HiFi Real‑Time Amplification Master Mix and 2 µL Illumina primers (5 µM). Pre‑PCR cycles with DNA in the 2000–10000 bp region indicate over‑amplification; a post‑PCR with 2 cycles and no DNA in that region confirms bubble removal and suitability for DASH. Use Agilent DNA High Sensitivity kit chips.

steps.title: Prepare Cas9‑gRNA master mix
steps.instruction: Anneal each dual‑guide RNA at 95 °C for 30 s then cool to room temperature (no further heating). Prepare a 2× Cas9‑gRNA master mix sufficient for all samples (enough for a second 1× mix later).

steps.title: Prepare DNA library input
steps.instruction: Ensure each library provides at least 10 µL of 2.8 nM DNA (≈0.83 ng/µL for a 450 bp average). If concentration is lower, concentrate by a 1:1 SPRI bead clean‑up.

steps.title: Pre‑incubate Cas9‑gRNA mix
steps.instruction: Gently pipette‑mix the 2× Cas9‑gRNA master mix and incubate at 37 °C for 5 min (00:05:00).

steps.title: Add library to Cas9‑gRNA mix
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of the 2.8 nM barcoded DNA library (pooled or individual) to 10 µL of the pre‑incubated Cas9‑gRNA mix (final volume 20 µL, 1× reaction). The reaction can be scaled proportionally (e.g., 40 µL for a 2× reaction).

steps.title: First DASH incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the 20 µL DASH reaction at 37 °C for 30 min (00:30:00).

steps.title: Prepare second Cas9‑gRNA mix
steps.instruction: While the first incubation proceeds, prepare a second 1× Cas9‑gRNA master mix for all samples and incubate this mix at 37 °C for 5 min (00:05:00).

steps.title: Column cleanup of first DASH
steps.instruction: Purify the reaction with Zymo DNA Clean & Concentrator‑5 kit (Catalog #D4014): add 100 µL binding buffer to the 20 µL DASH reaction, bind to column, wash as per kit, elute in 10.5 µL H₂O, reload the eluate onto the same column and elute again in 10.5 µL H₂O.

steps.title: Second DASH incubation
steps.instruction: Add the 10.5 µL eluate to 10 µL of the second 1× Cas9‑gRNA mix, mix, and incubate at 37 °C for 1 h 30 min (01:30:00). Total time of DNA in Cas9‑gRNA mix should be 2 h (02:00:00).

steps.title: Proteinase K treatment
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL Proteinase K (NEB Catalog #P8107S) to each 20 µL reaction, mix gently, and incubate at 50 °C for 15 min (00:15:00) to inactivate Cas9.

steps.title: SPRI bead purification
steps.instruction: Purify the reaction with SPRI beads at a 0.9× sample‑to‑bead ratio (equivalent to Ampure 0.7×).

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate homemade or Ampure XP beads to room temperature and vortex.
Add 0.9× volume of beads (e.g., 18.9 µL beads to 21 µL sample).
Mix by pipetting or tapping, then spin briefly.
Place tubes on a magnetic rack; allow beads to separate 3–5 min until supernatant is clear.
While on magnet, remove and discard supernatant.
Add 200 µL freshly prepared 80 % ethanol, incubate 1 min, then discard ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more.
Air‑dry beads for ~5 min; avoid over‑drying (beads should be matte, not cracked).
Remove tubes from magnet and add 27 µL nuclease‑free H₂O.
Resuspend beads by vortexing, tapping, and brief spin.
Incubate 2 min for DNA to elute, then place tubes back on magnet.
Collect 25 µL of clear supernatant and transfer to a clean PCR tube.

steps.title: Assess DASH outcome
steps.instruction: Run a fragment analysis (Agilent HS dsDNA Bioanalyzer kit or HS D5000 TapeStation). Successful DASH shows small peaks between 30–100 bp (digested fragments/gRNAs 30–140 bp), an adapter dimer at ~178 bp, and a low‑concentration target library sloping from ~300 to >1000 bp. Internal markers appear at 35 bp (green) and 10380 bp (purple). If peaks indicate incomplete depletion, perform additional cleanup and/or amplification.

steps.title: Optional Qubit quantification
steps.instruction: Measure library concentration with a Qubit dsDNA HS assay (Life Technologies Catalog #Q32851).

steps.title: Real‑time PCR amplification (if needed)
steps.instruction: If library concentration after cleanup is insufficient for sequencing, perform a Kapa HiFi Real‑Time PCR amplification.

substeps.instruction: Thaw Kapa HiFi Real‑Time Amplification Master Mix, Standard 2, and Illumina P5/P7 primers (5 µM combined) on ice (Kit Catalog #KK2702; P5 sequence 5’ AATGATACGGCGACCACCGAGATCT; P7 sequence 5’ CAAGCAGAAGACGGCATACGAGAT).
Place each sample in an individual tube or strip.
Add 50 µL Standard 2 to each tube.
Run the RT‑PCR program (baseline correction disabled).
Monitor the qPCR fluorescence; when a sample reaches the fluorescence threshold defined by Standard 2, remove that tube during the 72 °C for 20 s step immediately after the plate read.

steps.title: Post‑amplification SPRI cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean the amplified library using the same SPRI bead protocol described in step 12 (sample:bead ratio 1:0.9) to remove amplification reagents; elute in an appropriate volume of nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Final assessment and optional repeats
steps.instruction: Re‑run fragment analysis and/or Qubit quantification. If target library in the 200–1000 bp range remains low or absent, repeat SPRI clean‑ups or perform another round of Real‑Time PCR amplification as needed.
